message: 二人の時間

name: Paqy
message: 「Poteh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, what's with the sudden weird noise?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I sense my beloved Ria-chan's presence. This way, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the shopping district's raffle area, you know? Wouldn't Senpai be at the Japanese sweets shop?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my? Synn-kun and Paa-chan, you came to try the raffle wheel too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-She's really here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yaho! B-93 spotted, moving in!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kiarih!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, if it isn't Paqy-han.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... That deep bass of a fan slicing the wind--undoubtedly a concealed iron fan... *thud*」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaah!? Paa-chan, hang in there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Ria-senpai is hugging Paqy... If he were conscious, he'd be dancing for joy.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My apologies. I thought another pest had come buzzing around Rii-a, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's definitely a lie. Besides, 'another'? Just how many people have you--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「He dodged it? My self-defense technique... Not bad at all, President-han.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... For self-defense, isn't that awfully aggressive?」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Akane-chan... Bad girl! No doing that.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sorry, sorry, please don't be so cross. I'm just in high spirits since it's been so long since I got to go out with Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Akane-chan, when you get excited, do you end up knocking out forty-five boys?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I totally understand how you feel.」

name: Synn
message: 「On nights when my dad came to stay over, I'd get so carried away that we'd fall asleep with each other locked in a figure-four leglock.」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh, hmm. Like when my big sis touches my boobs, maybe...?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You understand, do you? That's our Student Council President for you. Here's a little present, then.」
Misasagi-senpai pinches Paqy up from Ria-senpai's cleavage and hands him over to me.

name: Misasagi
message: 「While we're spinning the garapon, be a dear and keep a firm hold on Paqy's reins, won't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, our target is the first-prize pair of hot spring trip tickets!\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Leave it to me♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... With the Kujou family and the Misasagi Zaibatsu, couldn't you easily go without winning it in a garapon?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「President.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's true that as the Kujou family and the Misasagi Zaibatsu, we could stay at a top-class ryokan all year round.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「However, once we step away from our family titles and are just 'Rii-a' and 'me,' that's not the case at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's go ahead and spin it already. Just like we decided with rock-paper-scissors, I'm going first!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Best of luck, Rii-a!」
Ria-senpai spins the garapon.

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02 Need a tissue?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't mind if I do!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「M-Mmh... Ria-chwaaan, rub-rub-rub.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, that tickles. That's my chest you're rubbing against.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Urk!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bweeeehhhh~~~」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How rude can a reaction get?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Looks like it's my turn next.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rest assured, I'll pull a winning ball in splendid fashion!」
Misasagi-senpai faces off against the lottery drum.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama, let's get out of here right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's no ordinary intensity, you know? How're you gonna smooth things over if she loses?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Prez, I'll give this to you. It's the 6th-prize salad oil set.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't mind if I do!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Phew...」

name: Ria
message: 「L-let's go shopping lots more and collect raffle tickets again, Akane-chan. Okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai, as a small token of thanks, I'd be happy to lend you my tent if you'd like.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Prez...?」

name: Synn
message: 「When I was a kid, I wanted to go camping, but for various reasons I couldn't go.」

name: Synn
message: 「So my mom pitched a tent in our yard for me, and we cooked rice in a mess tin there, stargazed at night, and slept in sleeping bags.」

name: Synn
message: 「We used the bathroom inside the house, and the yard was tiny as a cat's forehead, but it was so much fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! S-sorry, Misasagi-senpai, you're older than me and here I am making a suggestion like that.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thank you kindly, Prez, I would love to borrow it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's decided! Now we just need to figure out whose yard to do it in.」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, it's stored in my apartment's shed, so let's go grab it.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's an older type of tent, though, so it's pretty tough to pitch, okay?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's quite alright, quite alright, that just makes it all the more fun.」
And so, I ended up lending my old-style tent to Misasagi-senpai.

name: Misasagi
message: 「You have yourself a wonderful junior there, Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph-hmph!」
